summary:
AstroHealth is a software-based astronaut health monitoring and decision-support platform designed to support crew health during long-duration space missions. It addresses the challenges of spaceflight, including radiation exposure, altered gravity, isolation, sleep disturbances, and physiological changes.

The platform integrates multiple health-monitoring features, including vital signs tracking (heart rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, and blood pressure), mental health and sleep monitoring, radiation exposure tracking, and spacecraft environmental monitoring. It also includes health analysis to identify unusual readings, compare measurements against personal baselines, and generate alerts. An interactive AI assistant helps astronauts understand their health information and access relevant insights.

By bringing different health indicators together in one platform, AstroHealth aims to make health monitoring more accessible, organized, and proactive. It demonstrates how software-based monitoring and data-driven analysis can support astronaut well-being, early identification of potential health concerns, and safer long-duration space exploration.
details:
AstroHealth – Astronaut Health Monitoring and Decision-Support Platform

AstroHealth is a web-based astronaut health monitoring and decision-support platform designed to support crew well-being during long-duration space missions. It provides a centralized interface for monitoring and analyzing astronaut health information, combining physiological measurements with mental wellness indicators.

The platform includes a dashboard for viewing vital signs such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, blood pressure, and body temperature. It also supports sleep, mood, stress, and fatigue tracking. Additional features include manual health data entry, simulated telemetry, historical health trends, personal baseline comparisons, rule-based anomaly detection, alerts, and an integrated health assistant.

AstroHealth aims to simplify health data interpretation by presenting measurements and trends through interactive visualizations, helping identify potential health concerns that may require attention. Its intended impact is to improve health awareness, support informed decision-making, and demonstrate the role of digital health technologies in future space exploration.

The project was developed using React.js, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, React Router, Recharts, and Lucide React. The development focused on a responsive interface, clear data visualization, modular components, and intuitive navigation. A key aspect of the project is integrating physical and mental wellness indicators into a single platform rather than treating them as separate monitoring systems.

The design considers the constraints of space missions, including the importance of centralized information, accessibility, efficient monitoring, and early identification of abnormal health patterns.
